description: Everything company-specific about the analyst report lives here. This is the ONLY file you edit to point the analyst profile at your own organization — the prompt, the schema, and the Word renderer all read from it. Nothing downstream hardcodes a company name, a work policy, or a jurisdiction. Ships filled in with a fictional example so the renderer runs out of the box; replace every value under `company`, `work_policy`, and `jurisdiction` with your own.

company.name: Northwind Robotics
company.industry: a hardware company building autonomous warehouse robots
company.context: Northwind Robotics builds autonomous warehouse robots. Series B, 140 people, hardware and software under one roof. A strong hire here has shipped physical product on a real schedule and is comfortable owning a subsystem end to end rather than specializing narrowly.

work_policy.label: mandatory 5-day-per-week onsite
work_policy.detail: All employees work onsite five days per week at the San Francisco office. There is no hybrid or remote arrangement for this role.

regulatory.note: Optional. Any clearance, citizenship, or export-control constraint that legitimately applies to the role. Leave `regimes` empty if none apply. Read docs/COMPLIANCE.md before adding one — export-control screening is narrowly permitted and is NOT a licence to ask about national origin.

jurisdiction.notes: Drives which protected characteristics the compliance scrub enforces. Set `state` to null and `state_framework` to [] for federal-only screening.

report.title: Talent Intelligence Report
report.recommendation_placeholder: PLEASE TYPE 1-2 SENTENCES ABOUT YOUR ASSESSMENT OF THE CANDIDATE HERE
